subject: The newcomers' landing camp on the flats: floodlights, a clerk at a folding table with a list, and in the background a line of small scarred hill people, roped together. No faces in detail; nothing violent shown.
notes: Barrens Part 3. Screenprint light. Barrens' own dun and red ground. Never show the Mocker itself: only what it leaves and who sees it.
